# Moray Logs

> Firewood supplier based in Elgin, Moray, Scotland, established April 2013. Sells kiln dried birch hardwood logs, seasoned softwood logs and kindling, delivered to homes across Moray. Orders by phone: 07876 454 130, or email moraylogs@gmail.com.

## Delivery
- Free delivery within 10 miles of Elgin, minimum order £50. This covers Elgin, New Elgin, Bishopmill, Lossiemouth, Lhanbryde, Urquhart, Duffus, Hopeman, Burghead, Cummingston, Alves, Miltonduff, Pluscarden, Kellas, Fogwatt, Longmorn, Birnie, Mosstodloch and Fochabers.
- Outside 10 miles, call to arrange delivery (for example Forres, Findhorn, Kinloss, Dallas, Rothes, Garmouth, Kingston, Spey Bay, Buckie, Portgordon, Keith, Aberlour, Craigellachie, Dufftown).

## Prices
- Net of Kiln Dried Birch Hardwood Logs: 1 net £9.50, 15 nets £140
- Barrow Bag of Kiln Dried Birch Hardwood Logs: 1 bag £70, 2 bags £130
- Builder Bag of Kiln Dried Birch Hardwood Logs: £135
- Half Pallet of Kiln Dried Birch Hardwood Logs (110cm x 117cm x 82cm): £270
- Barrow Bag of Seasoned Softwood Logs: 1 bag £45, 2 bags £80
- Builder Bag of Seasoned Softwood Logs: 1 bag £70, 2 bags £130
- Half Pallet of Seasoned Softwood Logs (110cm x 117cm x 82cm): £130
- Large Bag of Kindling: 1 bag £7, 3 bags £20

## About the logs
- Kiln dried birch is below 20% moisture. Seasoned logs are around 20%.
- Logs are cut between 20cm and 40cm to fit all fires and stoves, and are ready to burn on delivery.
